list.title: Invoice templates
list.description: The PDF layouts invoices are printed with. A partner's own default wins over the global one.
list.emptyHint: Create a template to control how invoices look when downloaded or e-mailed.

editor.name: Name
editor.nameTooLong: Name must be at most 200 characters.
editor.scopeHint: Global templates can be used for every partner. A partner template is offered for that partner only.
editor.isDefaultHint: Used for invoices that do not name a template in this scope.
editor.isDefaultOn: This is the default for its scope
editor.deleteDescription: “{{name}}” will be removed. Invoices that used it fall back to the default template.
editor.deleteDefaultBlocked: A default template cannot be deleted. Set another template as default first.
editor.defaultSet: Now the default template for this scope
editor.notFoundHint: It may have been deleted by a colleague.
editor.loadError: The template could not be loaded
editor.usedByPdf: The PDF is currently built from the {{source}}. Editing here switches it.

blocks.emptyHint: Add blocks from the palette to build the page, top to bottom.
blocks.noneSelected: Select a block to edit its settings

inspector.title: Block settings
inspector.textHint: Use the chips to insert invoice data. Line breaks are kept.
inspector.imageHint: PNG, JPG, SVG or WebP up to 1 MB. It is embedded in the template; nothing is uploaded anywhere.
inspector.imageTooLarge: The image is larger than 1 MB.
inspector.imageReadError: The image could not be read.
inspector.noImage: No image selected. Nothing is printed until you add one.
inspector.label: Heading
inspector.pageNumberHint: Printed in the page footer of the PDF.
inspector.lineItemsHint: Lists every subscription, ad-hoc and project line with the subtotal.
inspector.tasksHint: Only printed when the invoice bills tasks. Shows points, the free allowance deduction and the subtotal.
inspector.totalsHint: Subtotal, VAT and the grand total with the green rule.

raw.fromBlocksHint: Replace the HTML with the markup of the block layout.
raw.confirmReplaceDescription: Your current HTML will be overwritten with the markup generated from the block layout.
raw.syntaxSection: repeat a list, or show when set
raw.syntaxInverted: show when empty or not set

tokens.title: Data tokens
tokens.hint: Click a token to insert it at the cursor.

signature.title: Signature
signature.description: A drawn signature is printed under the document, above the line “Authorised signature”. It is stored with the template as a PNG.
signature.dialogDescription: Sign with the mouse, a trackpad or your finger. The image is exported at 600 × 200 pixels.

preview.title: Live preview
preview.sample: Sample invoice: Zemo Systems, 3 subscription lines, 2 tasks, VAT
preview.error: The preview could not be rendered
